text_block_list.text: It happened one day in February—

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Then let's hit the supermarket after 
school! I'll go reserve the dorm kitchen~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
I see, reservations are totally required 
this time of year, huh. Thanks! This year, 
I'm making it by hand for sure~! Bring it 
on!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It's Valentine's Day, Duramente-san!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Ah. I see.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I see... Wait, isn't that a super 
important event?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Look, everyone looks forward to it just as 
much as Christmas! The grand festival for 
idols!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Duramente-chan. It's not just the 
fans, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Friends, family, mentors... Conveying your 
feelings to the precious people you love.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think Valentine's Day is full of 
happiness, just like a hot bowl of chanko 
nabe~☆

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at that face! Looks like you've 
got someone special you love lots, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...Duramente-chan. I'm hosting a 
sweets-making class leading up to 
Valentine's Day~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, please come visit~! I'll 
have recipes ready that'll make everyone 
smile♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Handmade, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(...No, my target, the Nakayama Kinen, is 
near. I should focus on the race for now.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I can express my gratitude anytime. For 
now, let's focus on training—)

With the Nakayama Kinen drawing closer at 
last, one day after training...

It was Valentine's Day, and the sweet 
scent filled the air all day long... Yet 
Duramente remained stoically focused on 
her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, going home.

What I gave Duramente was chocolate bought 
from a department store. It had a high 
cocoa content and was rich in nutritional 
value.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Did you prepare this for me?
choice_data_list: You always work so hard, after all.
You always work so hard, you know.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I haven't prepared anything for you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: But...—
choice_data_list: You'll bring me results, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list:
I'm looking forward to the "Nakayama 
Kinen"!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It will take a little time, but I'll 
prepare the greatest Valentine's present 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Count on me.

She seemed to have something she wanted to 
say, but showed no sign of opening her 
mouth. So while waiting for her, I decided 
to talk about what I felt today.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Why so suddenly?
choice_data_list: Since you worked so hard again today,

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: That is... only natural.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Without putting in the effort, you won't 
get what you're after.
choice_data_list: That's what I'm looking for as well.
That is something I seek as well.

text_block_list.text:
What she seeks—victory, crowns, pride, 
validation... and the scenery of the 
world. All of it is what I, as her 
Trainer, also wish for and pursue.

Because the Umamusume work so hard, even 
Trainers, who lack legs like theirs, can 
dare to dream—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, forgive me!

...When I tried to express my gratitude, 
they ran away.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —...Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Duramente-chan~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: What's the matter, why in such a rush~?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any more... recipes that "make 
people smile"?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I have someone too. Someone I want to make 
smile...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I thought it wasn't necessary right now... 
but that wasn't the case.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"It has to be right now. ...Please, let 
me... make one too!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. I see, I see~. Then we'd better 
hurry and wash our hands!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The recipe isn't going anywhere, but 
Valentine's Day will be gone before you 
know it~ Let's put our all into making it, 
Duramente-chan!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you...!

A few hours after Duramente disappeared 
once training ended. Finally, she replied 
back.

"Pleas come to the front gat" —A slightly 
misspelled message on LANE caught my eye. 
So I rushed over to the front gate...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's chocolate. ...I was just making it a 
moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The truth is... I didn't plan on giving it 
to you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If giving chocolate on Valentine's Day is 
about expressing gratitude... then I can 
do that anytime.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: But that wasn't the case.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Because I can tell them anytime. ...No, I 
have to tell them right now.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
There's no guarantee that "someday" will 
ever come.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything as always, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Always watching over me. Always 
thinking of me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... for sharing the same dream 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me. My words are an absolute 
mess."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I want to convey my feelings properly, 
just like you do.
choice_data_list: I got the message, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Still... these chocolates might be an even 
bigger mess than my words.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I made it in a rush, too... I ran all the 
way here from the dorms with everything I 
had.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...And after I went through the trouble of 
making it with a recipe guaranteed to 
bring a smile, too.
choice_data_list: Then isn't that a huge success?!
Then it was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Because, take a good look at me—
Because, take a good look at me—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...You're right.
